title: Agent memory: new repos a month
description: New Python GitHub repos and new arXiv papers per month matching agent-memory terms, Jan 2024 to Oct 2026, each line on its own scale: repos went from 12 a month to 2,809, papers to 117. Replicated from the team's own chart.
source: The team's own chart (arXiv API and GitHub search, pulled 2026-11-18), replicated. 12, 2,809 and 117 are its figures; the months between are traced from its lines (see DATA in index.html) until the export replaces them.
